steps: Product designates the exact synthetic non-Admin shared identity or explicitly authorizes creation; verify normal signed caller and existing capabilities, without changing permissions.
Employee-scoped read-only catalog lookup pins one exact identity/supplier/unit; produce the one-line synthetic PDF and SHA, then present this final concrete plan for Product canary approval.

Confirm the accepted deployed source, private attachment policies, default-off state, durable spending availability/expiry and separately completed hosted integration gates. Set only the finite approved pilot controls/allowlist; keep all other employees and TenOps UI excluded.

Use real native-original Terra extraction and autonomous catalog investigation through normal TenBot Messaging. If the result is ambiguous, warns of an unexplained potential duplicate, changes quantity/unit or requires a new catalog/Job entry, stop before approval.
Employee checks one exact line and order metadata, saves server review, verifies original hash and immutable draft hash, then explicitly approves. No model text supplies authorization.

Record the actual returned single pending ID/draft/approval/source identity, verify that exact row in Inventory Pending Receivals using the same caller, received quantity zero, exact quantity/unit, no Job link and no created catalog records. Verify original private access, durable audit/idempotent result and unchanged on-hand/transaction state.

If an HTTP result is uncertain, inspect the durable exact draft/receipt under fresh caller authorization; retry only the same immutable operation if the service indicates safe reconciliation. Never regenerate an invoice/reference, discard uncertain spend or start a second batch to bypass uncertainty.
Disable pilot/execute controls and clear enrollment immediately after the one operation; retain ordinary Terra/Qwen configuration and the separately approved cleanup schedule.

With Product preapproval and employee confirmation, use the existing Inventory Cancel action on only the returned unreceived canary pending ID. Never click Receive, delete rows, purge source/audit metadata or alter catalog/stock. Verify status cancelled and unchanged stock.
